decisions.description: Spend is below the planned review threshold and conversions are absent.
decisions.reason: There is not enough signal to judge conversion performance.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Review after the planned spend threshold, 72 hours, or 3 conversion events.

decisions.description: Campaign objective is Traffic while the Ad Mission goal is sales.
decisions.recommendation: Fix objective alignment before judging sales performance.
decisions.reason: Traffic can produce cheap visits that do not represent purchase intent.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Run preflight again after rebuilding or correcting the campaign.

decisions.description: Clicks are cheap but conversions are absent.
decisions.recommendation: Audit offer, landing, tracking, and creative before adding ad sets.
decisions.reason: The bottleneck is more likely post-click alignment than audience complexity.
decisions.reviewTrigger: Review after landing or creative changes have enough new spend.
